desc: Module for the manipulation of script functions. Allows for detouring existing functions, and checking if a function exists to avoid compiler/resolver errors.

builtins.name: getFunction
builtins.desc:
Returns {function_pointer} based on <function_path> and <function_name>.
Does not trigger compilation or resolving of the script, therefore if the script isn't referenced by an include or far call by any other script at least once it will fail to find the function and return undefined.
builtins.notes:
Useful in situations where you would like to reference a function that does not always exist in every context(map, gametype, game etc), without a unresolved external or compiler error occurring.
Fails when <function_path> and <function_name> cannot be resolved to a linked function.

returns.name: function_pointer
returns.desc: Undefined if function could not be found or a function pointer to <function_name>.

args.name: function_path
args.desc:
Path to try to find function. Standard is to use forward slashes and not escaped backslashes. Script instance must match(gsc to gsc, or csc to csc). Is only the <function_path> component of a far call: <function_path>::<function_name>
any script path; example: 'maps/mp/_utility' or 'maps\\mp\\_utility'

args.name: function_name
args.desc:
Function to retrive a pointer for. The <function_name> component of a far call: <function_path>::<function_name>
any script function name

builtins.name: getFunctionName
builtins.desc: Returns {function_name} of the input <function_pointer> in "function_path::function_name" format.
builtins.notes: Useful for debugging when you would like to print the name of an arbitrary function pointer.

returns.name: function_name
returns.desc: The string representation of the <function_pointer> as '<function_path>::<function_name>'.

args.name: function_pointer
args.desc:
Script function to try to get the name of.
any script function

builtins.name: replaceFunc
builtins.desc:
Detours <from_function> to <to_function> causing subsequent calls to <from_function> to instead call <to_function>.
Can detour any function including engine invoked script callbacks, except builtins. If [priority] is not specified defaults to 0 allowing for successive replacefunc calls with a higher [priority] value to detour already detoured functions.
builtins.notes:
Allows overriding existing vanilla behavior by overriding <from_function> to call your own <to_function>.
Fails if the replacefunc call's priority is lower than an existing detour's priority.
Due to when the script VM may execute; if you want to guarantee your code overriding the original behavior you need to invoke replacefunc as early as possible. The best way to do that is in the main() of a custom script. Additionally, using replacefunc in tandem with getfunction can allow your script to be gametype/map/mode agnostic.
T6 ONLY: You can use the command "listscriptdetours" to list the currently applied detours from replacefunc calls.
Replaced funcs are cleared on fast_restart and currently do not save to the savefile.

args.name: from_function
args.desc:
Script function to replace calls to.
any script function

args.name: to_function
args.desc:
Script function to detour to.
any script function

args.name: priority
args.desc:
Priority value for successive replacefunc calls; the highest priority overall is what is called.
any signed integer

builtins.name: getDetour
builtins.desc: Given a <function_pointer>, return the current {function_detour} for that function.
builtins.notes:
Allows for checking if an existing detour is applied to <function_pointer> and get a reference to {function_detour}.
Fails when <function_pointer> does not have a {function_detour}.
throws: When <function_pointer> does not have a {function_detour}. ie: the function was not called with replacefunc.

returns.name: function_detour
returns.desc: The function pointer to the detour.

args.name: function_pointer
args.desc:
Script function that has been replaced, to get {function_detour} for.
any script function

builtins.name: removeDetour
builtins.desc: Given a <function_pointer>, remove the detour from <function_pointer>.
builtins.notes: When you want to restore a detour'd function back to just calling the original function.
throws: When <function_pointer> was not replace func'd. ie: the function was not called with replacefunc.

args.name: function_pointer
args.desc:
A function pointer that has been detour'd by a call to replacefunc.
any script function that is detour'd

builtins.name: disableDetourOnce
builtins.desc: Given a <function_pointer>, disable the detour from <function_pointer> for only one call.
builtins.notes: When you want to call the original function for only one time, useful for 'hooking' function calls.
throws: When <function_pointer> was not replace func'd. ie: the function was not called with replacefunc.

args.name: function_pointer
args.desc:
A function pointer that has been detour'd by a call to replacefunc.
any script function that is detour'd
